Primary output is required kLa at Da=1, conditional on oxygen uptake and saturation. Da=OUR/(kLa*Cstar) describes bulk transfer capacity at maximal driving force, not actual dissolved oxygen or aggregate-core oxygen. Peak density is the maximum condition-day mean; the maximum individual value is supplied separately. The 100-mL correlation uses Neto's verified 41.5-mm wheel, exact source contact area and original temperature-dependent water-property functions. The 37 C Schmidt value is outside the experimental fitting range; the paper supports temperature extension numerically. Estimates remain conditional on water-to-medium and headspace transferability. The 500-mL kLa is assumed. Sensitivity ranges are exploratory, not empirical uncertainty bounds. No hypoxia exclusion or oxygen-replete classification is made. Neto's measurements used uncapped water vessels; applicability to culture medium/headspace conditions is limited.
